text: Essential reading for any developer. The chapter on orthogonality alone changed how I structure modules.
Timeless advice, though a few of the tooling examples have aged badly. Skim those and keep the principles.
The clearest explanation of consistency models I have read anywhere. Chapter 9 is worth the price of the book.
Dense for the first hundred pages, then completely absorbing. The ecology of Arrakis is the real main character.
I respect it more than I enjoyed it. The politics are excellent, the pacing in the middle third is not.
Pure problem-solving joy. Rocky is the best non-human character in recent science fiction.
The appendix on Newspeak is the part that stayed with me longest. Read it as a book about language.
Excellent on the mechanics of judgement, less convincing where it leans on priming research that did not replicate.
Repetitive by design, since he was writing to himself. Better read a page at a time than cover to cover.
